pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Transfers health to another creature, using the health taken from you while charging.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 10.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Hold the ability key while looking at a target. Each charge costs one heart, but your health cannot fall below half a heart. Release the key to send white smoke that restores health to the target according to the charge.
